name: EuroPMCAnnot_get_article_annotations
description: Get text-mined annotations from one scientific article using Europe PMC, with limit/offset pagination and explicit total/has_more metadata. Returns exact text, context, ontology links, section, provider, and tags. The human-facing annotation type 'Genes & Proteins' is translated to Europe PMC's required API token and both values are reported in metadata.

article_id.description: Article identifier in format 'PMC:PMCXXXXXXX' or 'MED:PMID'. Examples: 'PMC:PMC4353746', 'PMC:PMC3531190', 'MED:25780448'.

annotation_type.description: Optional annotation type. Common values: 'Chemicals', 'Organisms', 'Gene Ontology', 'Diseases', 'Genes & Proteins' (mapped explicitly to API token 'Gene_Proteins'), 'Accession Numbers'. Default: all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of annotations to return in this page.

offset.description: Zero-based annotation offset. Use data.next_offset for the next page.

name: EuroPMCAnnot_get_annotations_by_type
description: Get annotations of one type from multiple Europe PMC articles. All supplied article IDs are requested upstream by default, and each article's annotations support limit/offset pagination with independent total/has_more metadata. 'Genes & Proteins' is explicitly mapped to the required 'Gene_Proteins' API token. Supports up to 200 article IDs per request.

article_ids.description: Comma-separated article identifiers. Format: 'PMC:PMCXXXXXXX' or 'MED:PMID'. Examples: 'PMC:PMC4353746,PMC:PMC3531190', 'MED:25780448,MED:23256780'. Max 200 articles.

annotation_type.description: Annotation type to retrieve. Common values: 'Chemicals', 'Organisms', 'Gene Ontology', 'Diseases', 'Genes & Proteins' (mapped to 'Gene_Proteins'), 'Accession Numbers'.

page_size.description: Upstream article page size. If omitted, the wrapper requests at least the number of supplied article IDs so Europe PMC's smaller default cannot silently omit articles. Max: 1000.

limit.description: Maximum number of annotations returned per article from the shared offset.

offset.description: Zero-based annotation offset applied independently within each returned article.

name: EuroPMCAnnot_get_chemicals_from_article
description: Extract chemical/compound mentions from one article using Europe PMC text mining, with limit/offset pagination and explicit total/has_more metadata. Returns ChEBI links, exact text, surrounding context, and section location.

limit.description: Maximum number of chemical mentions to return in this page.

offset.description: Zero-based chemical-mention offset. Use data.next_offset for the next page.
